controls: clean, negative, unknown and semantic programs are scored as in protocol v1.1 at the update layer (negatives: identical to partner; clean detections: findings to verify)

adamw_history.moments: EMA of the family's CLEAN program outputs over history seeds H_s = {20000 + 16 s + i, i = 0..15} (16 steps), bias-corrected with t = 17 at the measured step; the same (theta, m, v, t) is used for K and for K_R

definitions.gradient: the program output y (row-major flattened) is the gradient g of a parameter block theta of the same shape
definitions.reference_replay: g_R = K_R as an interval; the optimizer step is propagated in interval arithmetic (or evaluated at lo/mid/hi with the hull taken and widened by 2 ulp, declared); u = step(K) - step(g_R)

rules.R3: w = -r/||r|| (positive = pushes less along the reference update)

definitions.scoring: delta mu = mu(variant) - mu(clean of the same family) under the designated rule; sign must match; magnitudes compared with the derivation
definitions.theta: theta_s ~ N(0,1), deterministic from the measurement seed s (torch Generator seed 5000+s)

adamw_history.derivation: u ~ -lr (1-beta1) delta / (sqrt(v_hat)+eps) per coordinate: same sign as SGD, magnitude ~0.1 x delta/sqrt(v_hat)

adamw_zero_moments.derivation: with m=v=0 and t=1 the AdamW update is lr * g/(|g|+eps): e changes the update only where |e| is comparable to |g| (sign flips or |g| ~ eps); pre-registered as a near-cancellation case

sgd.derivation: u = -lr e: a uniform downward shift of e becomes a uniform upward shift of u (R1 sign flips)

adamw_history.derivation: first order: u ~ -lr (1-beta1) e / (sqrt(v_hat)+eps) minus a (1-beta2) term; with history moments the current step enters m with weight (1-beta1)=0.1, so the effect survives at about 0.1 x the SGD ratio |mu|/||r||

adamw_zero_moments.derivation: with m=v=0 and t=1 the AdamW update is lr * g/(|g|+eps): e changes the update only where |e| is comparable to |g| (sign flips or |g| ~ eps); pre-registered as a near-cancellation case

sgd.derivation: u = -lr e exactly; e and r both flip sign, so R3 keeps the output-layer sign; |mu| = lr * c * ||K_R|| ~ SGD scale
